dossiers.financial_spine: Dominant NE-India cement leader (~1/2 of the Northeast market) with a durable freight/logistics moat plus fiscal (SGST/GST-refund) incentives that drive industry-best EBITDA/tonne (~Rs1,738 FY26, Rs1,871 Q1-FY27). FY26 was a sharp recovery, not a decay: revenue Rs3,776cr, EBITDA Rs944-955cr (+60%), PAT Rs390cr (vs Rs169cr FY25), ROCE 16.7% on a near-net-cash balance sheet. The real debate is the ~Rs4,800cr East (Bihar)+North (Nimbol/Haryana) expansion through ~FY29, which dilutes blended margin/ROCE and deliberately levers the fortress. This is a VALUATION reset (stock -34% off 52wk high) on an IMPROVING franchise, NOT a quality/margin-erosion over-rate; at ~9x trailing EV/EBITDA it is cheap vs peers, so composite ~72 is fair-to-conservative and the buy is coherent.
dossiers.drivers: NE volume (~1/2 share, 2,000 dealers/12,000 sub-dealers) + premium/blended mix; new capacity ramp (Silchar/Cachar 2MTPA live Feb-26; East/North grinding+clinker to FY29) driving ~10-12% FY27 volume growth; firm NE realization/pricing (OPM ~27%, 8-qtr high); SGST/GST incentive income (Rs184cr FY26); cost levers = rising low-cost green-energy share offsetting petcoke/coal.
dossiers.dependencies: NE incentive/SGST-refund durability (Rs184cr FY26 -> ~Rs145-150cr FY27, ~19% of EBITDA, stepping down 5-7yr grinding refunds); East/North mainland competition (oversupplied, ~Rs800-1,200/t vs NE ~Rs1,700-1,900/t); regional cement demand+pricing cycle (monsoon/election softness flagged Q1-Q2 FY27); petcoke/coal cost; capex execution + funding discipline (Rs4,800cr through ~FY29, target net-debt/EBITDA <1.5x).
dossiers.forensics: Near net-cash: net debt ~Rs220cr (total debt ~Rs603cr less cash ~Rs125cr + investments ~Rs258cr), net-debt/EBITDA ~0.2x; borrowings rose Rs72cr->Rs603cr over 2yrs = expected capex funding, not distress. Cash quality solid: OCF FY26 Rs765cr vs PAT Rs390cr => OCF/PAT ~1.96x; FCF modestly negative on Rs843cr investing (expansion by design; pre-capex FCF strongly +). ROCE recovered to 16.7% (from ~8-13% trough) but will dilute during FY27-29 build. EBITDA/tonne Rs1,738->Rs1,871 near cyclical high; ~19% of EBITDA is incentive income = the top earnings-quality caveat (recurring-but-policy-dependent, tapering). Debtor days ~23 (clean); inventory days ~343 is a Screener artifact (limestone/clinker + mining stripping), not channel-stuffing. Governance clean: promoter 58.1% and RISING (open-market buys, no pledge), UltraTech strategic 8.42%; only flag is thin institutional float (~5% MF+FII) which amplified the de-rate. Valuation NOT rich: EV ~Rs8,524cr => ~9.0x trailing / ~7.8-8.5x FY27E EV/EBITDA and ~Rs8,800-11,100/t (~replacement) vs Dalmia ~21x / JK ~26x / Nuvoco ~16x FY27E; the SELL Rs180-190 bear note is built on MISLABELED trough EPS and is rejected.

valuation.method: mid-cycle EV/EBITDA 8.5-10x on normalized ~Rs1,050-1,100cr EBITDA (haircut for incentive taper + mainland dilution + price fade) + near-net-cash addback; cross-checked EV/tonne ~replacement

dossiers.prediction: 30/60/90d: tracks-to-modestly-outperforms Nifty (0 to +8% rel); near 52wk low with recovered earnings + thin float + Strong-Buy consensus (avg TP ~Rs279) = upside skew. BULL-CONFIRM: Q2-FY27 volume +8-12% YoY AND EBITDA/tonne >=Rs1,650 AND net-debt/EBITDA <0.6x -> +10-15% vs Nifty, keep buy. BEAR-FALSIFIER (flip to hold/trim): any two of (i) EBITDA/tonne <~Rs1,400 on NE price rollover, (ii) incentive taper guided worse than -Rs50cr, (iii) net-debt/EBITDA jumps toward/above 1.5x early, (iv) mainland realizations force blended-margin guide-down. HARD DOWN-FALSIFIER: holds below Rs190 on fundamental news -> exit.

dossiers.financial_spine: DELISTED GHOST — do NOT carry as a live rec. Cigniti was India's largest independent software-testing / Quality Engineering / Digital Assurance IT pure-play (BlueSwan AI-assurance), consol rev ~Rs2,014cr FY25 / ~Rs2,211cr TTM, PAT ~Rs200->302cr TTM, OPM 14->17%, ROCE ~34%, debt-free — a genuine earnings base. CRITICAL: it is now a dissolved Coforge subsidiary — amalgamated into Coforge (NCLT-sanctioned, effective 5 May 2026, trading halted 15 May, 1:1 share swap), so CIGNITITEC no longer trades and its financials fully consolidate into Coforge. The engine's cmp Rs1,260.3 / composite ~70 / 'cheap' P/E 11.4 are STALE frozen-tick + legacy-standalone artifacts of a security that no longer trades; true look-through = COFORGE ~Rs1,508 (a holder is ~+20% via the swap, not -2%). Correct action: RE-MAP to COFORGE (1:1) and re-underwrite, or resolve/close the rec as a completed corporate action.
dossiers.drivers: Digital-assurance/continuous-quality secular demand; Coforge cross-sell into a larger BFSI/insurance wallet; AI-led assurance (BlueSwan impact-analyzer cut one client regression >=40%); US/UK BFSI-heavy mix; offshore delivery.
dossiers.dependencies: Coforge parent — integration/merger/swap-ratio risk RESOLVED (1:1 parity, NCLT-sanctioned, 99.95% approval, no minority squeeze); AI-automation threat to labor-arb testing (offset by AI-assurance demand); IT-services demand cycle; USD/INR.
dossiers.forensics: Clean: net cash/debt-free, ROCE ~34%, ROE ~26%, interest coverage ~87x, current ratio ~4.8x; OCF Rs159cr FY25 vs PAT Rs200cr (OCF/PAT ~0.8). The dominant fact is the Coforge amalgamation — COMPLETE and FAVORABLE to minorities (1:1 par swap), so minority risk is behind not ahead. The real flag is DATA-INTEGRITY: the engine holds a delisted ticker as an active buy at a frozen Rs1,260 tick (last price 2026-05-14; standalone 'rev -44%' is a merger distortion to ignore). Look-through valuation = COFORGE ~28x trailing / ~21x fwd / ~8x P/B — a premium vs mid-cap-IT ~18x fwd, richer than the 11.4x stale screen implied.

valuation.method: merger-ratio-implied: 1 CIGNITITEC = 1 COFORGE share; P/E on Coforge earnings + consensus (COFORGE CMP Rs1,508, avg target Rs1,716). NOT a fresh buy signal — a realized swap cushion.

dossiers.prediction: No independent price path (dissolved) — all forecasts belong to COFORGE: 30/60/90d roughly in-line-to-modest-under Nifty given rich multiple + AI-arb overhang (target Rs1,716 bull / Rs1,400 bear). HARD FALSIFIER: any new CIGNITITEC trade tick after 14 May 2026 (none will occur). EVENT: merger already consummated (5-16 May 2026); residual is only Coforge-share settlement to lagging demat holders.

dossiers.financial_spine: 2W auto-lighting leader (LED head/tail lamps, mirrors) with Honda/HMSI historically ~45% but de-risked to ~high-20s-30% today; TVS+HMSI top-2 ~51%. FY26 rev Rs2,816cr (+16%), PAT Rs256cr (+24%), EBITDA margin record 14.1% driven by LED mix-up (63% of auto-lighting, ~2x realisation) not a commodity spike. EV-2W content is real optionality but unquantified. Earnings genuine; at ~23-24x it trades at a DISCOUNT to lighting peers, so composite ~67 is fair, not an over-rate — the live buy is coherent (hold/accumulate-on-dips).
dossiers.drivers: 2W demand cycle (India record 26.7m units FY26, Fiem growing above industry); LED content-per-vehicle uplift (~2x conventional, 100% of new pipeline LED); EV-2W content per vehicle (supplies TVS iQube/Ola/Ather/Hero/Honda Activa EV); nascent 4W/PV diversification (~Rs700cr RFQ, SOP FY28, Mahindra live, Mercedes RFQ); LED luminaire non-auto.
dossiers.dependencies: Honda/HMSI single-client concentration (~high-20s-30%, improving but permanent); 2W-cycle rollover risk after a record year; EV-transition client-mix risk (legacy ICE OEMs losing share); input/copper-plastic costs; competition (Uno Minda, Lumax, Varroc); capex execution on Rs400cr 4W+base plan; key-person (CEO resigned May-26, founder Jains re-took C-suite).
dossiers.forensics: Net cash ~Rs205cr (borrowings Rs66cr vs cash/inv Rs271cr), ND/EBITDA ~-0.5x — fortress. ROCE 29.3%, ROE 22.6%, dividend Rs40 payout 41% self-funded. AMBER: FY26 OCF Rs161cr vs PAT Rs256cr = 0.63x (FY25 was 1.14x); debtor days 40.5->50.2 — working-capital/growth drag, not revenue-recognition games; caps FCF to ~Rs25-60cr. Promoter 54.5% (down ~12%/3yr) but NIL pledge/encumbrance (filed Apr-26) = watch-item not break. Two fires, ~Rs82.3cr insurance claim — check other-income for write-backs. Valuation: P/E ~23-24x = ~15% DISCOUNT to peer median 27.3x and vs Uno Minda 52-69x/Lumax 31x; re-rated 8.5x(2019)->18x(FY24)->24x now. EV optionality only PARTIALLY priced. Full-but-fair.

valuation.method: FY27E EPS ~Rs111-114 (15-18% growth) x 18-24x justified fwd multiple; peer-relative with concentration+small-cap+cash-conversion haircut; consensus ~Rs2700

dossiers.prediction: Base: in-line to +3-5% vs Nifty over 90d (fairly valued, drifts with earnings/2W data). Bull trigger +5-10%: disclosed EV/PV order-book or OCF/PAT snap-back >1x. Bear trigger -5-10%: 2W volumes roll over OR Q1FY27 OCF/PAT <0.7x + debtor days >55. Bull FALSIFIER: EBITDA margin <12.5% or OCF/PAT <0.6x for a 2nd straight year or promoter sale+fresh pledge. Over-rate FALSIFIER: margins hold >=14%, growth >=15%, cash-conversion recovers >=0.9x -> discount closes, Rs2700+ justified.
